error_network: Can't reach the server. Try again.

activity_very_active_hint: Daily intense exercise or physical job
objective_recomp_hint: Recomposition: slight deficit + very high protein
ob_diet_text: The diet module tracks calories, macros and meals. You can enable it anytime.
feedback_desc_placeholder: Tell us what happened or your suggestion…
achievement_share_text: I just unlocked the "{name}" achievement on {app}! {description}
achievement_share_copied: Copied! Paste it anywhere to share.
holiday_natal_desc: Wrap up the year strong and healthy.
birthday_message: May your new year be full of workouts and wins. Let's go!
weight_need_more: Log one more weight to see the trend.
bmi_cat_underweight_text: A bit below the healthy range — worth boosting your intake.
bmi_cat_normal_text: Right in the healthy range, nice work! 🎉
bmi_cat_overweight_text: Slightly above the recommended range — no panic, it's just one indicator.
bmi_cat_obese1_text: Above the recommended range. A good time to adjust your routine.
bmi_cat_obese2_text: Well above the recommended range — worth seeking professional guidance.
bmi_cat_obese3_text: Well above the recommended range — definitely worth professional guidance.
bmi_caveat_title: A general indicator, not the full picture
bmi_caveat_text: BMI doesn't assess body composition — it can't tell muscle from fat. Athletes or people with a lot of muscle mass can land in the "overweight" range without excess fat. Treat it as a starting point, not a final verdict.
tdee_info_text: The total calories you burn in a day — basal metabolism plus activity level. It's your maintenance: eating at this amount keeps your weight stable.
bmr_info_text: How much your body burns at full rest, just for vital functions (breathing, heartbeat, etc.) — before any activity in your day.
guide_pointer_text: Want to understand all the formulas, acronyms and tips?
guide_pointer_link: See the full Guide in your Profile
workout_coming: Your workout will show up here
diet_coming: Your food diary will show up here
progress_coming: Weight, water and trends will show up here
no_routines_text: Pick how many times a week you train and we'll create a ready-to-edit plan.
no_workout_that_day: No workout logged on this day.
activity_estimate_auto_hint: Calculated from type, intensity and duration — you can edit the number directly.
movement_hint: Alternates between the start and end of the movement
add_workout_how: How do you want to build it?
add_workout_quick_text: The app builds the workouts for you: just say how many days a week you train. You can change everything later.
add_workout_scratch_text: You pick every exercise, the sets and the reps.
archive_routine_confirm: Archive it? It leaves the cycle but stays saved, and you can bring it back whenever you want.
unarchive_routine_confirm: Bring it back? It returns as the last one in the cycle.
archive_current_routines_confirm: Archive the {count} routines in the current cycle?
routine_unarchived_toast: Routine is back in the cycle.
archive_offer_body: You have a new workout in the cycle and {count} that are past their date. Want to archive the old ones?
vary_today_archive_question: Using the variation today creates a new workout. What about the original routine?
template_adds_hint: This adds new routines to the ones you already have.
no_goal_yet: Set up your profile to see goals.
pantry_cta: Build a meal with what I have
pantry_hint: Tap what you have at home
pantry_staples_note: Staples (olive oil, garlic, onion, salt, sugar) always count as something you have.
pantry_no_recipe_matches: No recipe matches yet. Tap 1 or 2 more items.
pantry_food_matches_label: Or just this, on its own
pantry_no_food_matches: Nothing on its own yet — anything you mark above also counts by itself.
supp_empty_hint: Track creatine, vitamins and the like as a daily habit.
adherence_no_data: Log your meals to see adherence.
periodization_text: The "{name}" routine has been active for {weeks} weeks. Varying the stimulus keeps you progressing.
cycle_active_text: Active for {active} wk · {remaining} wk left before reviewing the stimulus.
cycle_due_text: Active for {weeks} weeks — past the mesocycle. Time to switch up the stimulus to keep progressing.
diet_period_measured: Your measured maintenance: {kcal} kcal · your goal would become {target} kcal
library_hint: Ready-made recipes — tap + to copy to yours and log them in the diary.
meal_order_saved: Order saved for the next days
no_recipes_text: Create recipes like an omelet and log them at once.
ext_search_failed: The online search did not respond. That does not mean the product is missing.
ext_search_hint: Tap a result to fill the fields (Open Food Facts).
repeat_meal_confirm: Repeat this meal from the previous day?
food_list_end: You've reached the end of the list.
cut_intensity_hint: How fast you want to lose fat. Faster demands more discipline and risks more muscle.
scale_data_hint: If you have a bioimpedance scale, enter its values.
confirm_delete: Delete? This action can't be undone.
delete_weigh_in_confirm: Delete this weigh-in? This can't be undone.
no_body_composition: This weigh-in only has the weight.
tape_data_hint: Optional. With waist and neck the app already estimates your body fat — works even without a scale.
tape_feeds_formula: Used in the body fat estimate
tape_formula_note: Fields marked • feed the body fat estimate. Arm, thigh and chest are for tracking only — limb circumference does not separate muscle from fat.
source_explain: Both are estimates: the scale is less accurate than the tape. What matters is each one's trend, not the exact number.
bc_help_what: You pick how much body fat you want to have and it shows what you would weigh at that point. That is all.
bc_help_how: Much of your body is not fat: it is muscle, bone and water. The calculation assumes you keep that part and lose only fat.
bc_help_not: Nothing else in the app changes. Your calorie goal, your macros, the food suggestions and the achievements all stay exactly the same — your goal still comes from the objective you picked in your profile.
bc_help_range: The scale has a margin of error in this measurement. An exact number would suggest a precision it does not have.
bc_trend_empty: This shows up once you have two weigh-ins at least 14 days apart. Any sooner and the scale's normal day-to-day swing speaks louder than the real change.
bc_target_choose: What body fat do you want to reach?
bc_target_premise: This assumes you lose only fat and keep the {lean} kg of muscle, bone and water you have today. If you lose muscle along the way you end up lighter — but with more fat than you planned.
bc_range_note: We show a range, not an exact number, because the scale has a margin of error in this measurement.
bc_lean_hint: Muscle, bone and water — everything that is not fat. This is what you want to keep while losing weight.
bc_prefilled_hint: Filled in from your {date} weigh-in. Change what is different.
bc_target_open: Work out my weight for a body fat target
coach_log_food: You haven't logged anything today. Log your meals to track calories.
coach_low_protein: Protein below target today. Prioritize a protein source in your next meal.
coach_drink_water: You've had little water today. How about a glass now?
coach_train: It's been a few days without training. Move your body today?
coach_visceral_tip: Tip: cutting liquid sugar (soda and juices) is what helps most to reduce belly fat.
weigh_reminder_hint: Always morning, fasted, after the bathroom.
adaptive_need_data: Log weight and food for about 3 weeks so the app can compute your real expenditure and adjust the goal.
adaptive_footnote: Estimated from what you ate and your weight trend over the last weeks.
adaptive_on_track: On the right pace. Keep it up.
adaptive_too_slow: Losing slower than target. Your real expenditure is below the formula — consider the suggested goal.
adaptive_stalled: Weight stalled. Lower to the suggested goal to start losing fat again.
adaptive_too_fast: Losing too fast. Raise calories a bit to preserve muscle.
adaptive_adopt_confirm: Replace the current goal with the suggested one?
adaptive_already_adopted: Your current goal already uses this measured real maintenance.
adaptive_cannot_adopt: Losing too fast in this reading — much of it is water, not fat. This estimate can't become your goal yet; wait for the next one.
adaptive_below_bmr: Your measured burn came out lower than what your body burns at rest ({bmr} kcal), which is not possible.
adaptive_cannot_adopt_below_bmr: This happens when the food diary is incomplete: days with no entries, or logged halfway, drag the average down. Log whole days — weekends included — and the estimate fixes itself.
delete_confirm_text: This permanently deletes your account and all your data. This cannot be undone.
error_user_not_found: We could not find anyone with that email.
error_source_item_gone: The item changed at the source. Ask them to share it again.
sharing_subtitle: Pass your recipes and foods to whoever trains with you.
sharing_invite_label: Email of the person you want to connect with
sharing_pending_sent: Invite sent, waiting for a reply
sharing_remove_hint: Whatever you already accepted stays with you.
sharing_no_connection_hint: Connect with someone in Profile to start sharing.
swap_hint: This swap applies to this workout only. Your routine stays as it is.
swap_never_done: you have not done this one yet
no_foods_title: No foods of your own yet
no_foods_text: Add what you eat that isn't in the catalog.
food_library_hint: Comes with the app and can be logged as is. Star the ones you eat often so they show up first.
cycle_optin_hint: Optional. Suggests foods for the phase — never changes your calorie target.
cycle_last_period_label: When did your most recent period start?
cycle_length_label: Days from one period to the next
cycle_stale_hint: It has been over a full cycle since the date you entered. Update it to keep the estimate useful.
cycle_focus_menstrual: Focus right now: iron and vitamin C — beans, lean beef, dark greens, orange
cycle_focus_follicular: Focus right now: lean protein and fresh food — egg, yogurt, quinoa, strawberry
cycle_focus_ovulatory: Focus right now: fibre and antioxidants — broccoli, avocado, chia, greens
cycle_focus_luteal: Focus right now: magnesium and fibre — banana, oats, nuts, 70% chocolate
error_cycle_date_required: Enter the first day of your last period.
error_cycle_date_future: That date is in the future. Enter the first day of your last period.
cycle_last_period_hint: If you are on your period now, this is the day it started — not last month's.
cycle_mode_hint: Don't remember the date? Choose "Pick the phase" and just say how you are right now.
cycle_length_hint: Counted from the first day of one period to the day before the next starts — not how many days you bleed. The average is 28; leave it if you are not sure.
tour_optin_hint: A short walkthrough in each area of the app.
tour_restart_confirm: Restart the tutorial from the beginning? The steps you have already seen will show up again.
tour_restarted_toast: Tutorial restarted. It begins in the next area you open.
tour_skip: Skip the tutorial for this area
tour_paused_toast: Tutorial paused. It picks up where you left off when you come back.
tour_skipped_toast: No problem, moving on without the tutorial here. You can turn it back on in Profile.
tour_done_toast: Done! You have seen the basics of this area.
tour_home_welcome_text: Let me show you where everything is. Just a few steps, and you can stop whenever you want.
tour_home_calories_text: This shows how much you have eaten and how much is left to hit today’s target.
tour_home_water_text: Tap the shortcuts to add a glass. The target comes from your weight.
tour_home_numbers_text: BMI (weight and height) up here, with TDEE (daily burn) and BMR (resting burn) just below. Tap the question mark on each one to see the math.
tour_home_tabs_text: This is how you move between areas. The first time you open each one, I explain what it does.
tour_workout_create_text: Tap here to build a workout: start fast by picking how many days a week you train, or build it from scratch, picking each exercise.
tour_workout_next_text: This is the workout of the day. Tap the card to see the exercises, start the workout, or mark it done when you finish.
tour_workout_calendar_text: The calendar marks training days and loose activity days, so you can see your consistency.
tour_workout_catalog_text: Hundreds of exercises with photos and muscle groups, to browse or to swap one you did not like.
tour_workout_activity_text: Log here whatever happened outside the gym. It joins your history alongside the workouts.
tour_diet_goals_text: Calories and macros (protein, carbs and fat) you have eaten, and how much still fits.
tour_diet_meals_text: Tap a meal to open it and log what you ate. Press and drag to reorder your day.
tour_diet_supplements_text: Creatine, vitamins and the like: add yours and check off what you have taken. Reminder only — it never counts toward calories.
tour_progress_weight_text: Your latest weight and the trend. The chart shows up from the second weigh-in — the line tells the story, not any single day.
tour_progress_week_text: Days in motion is the headline number: consistency beats the perfect workout.
tour_progress_body_text: Fat, muscle and water from your bioimpedance scale (BIA) or tape measure. Watch the trend, not the exact value.
tour_progress_adaptive_text: The app compares what you ate with how your body responded and corrects the target on its own. No math on you.
tour_profile_achievements_text: The bar fills as you train and log. Tap to see your badges and what is left for the next one.
tour_profile_sharing_text: Perfect for people who live together and eat the same meals: invite them and every recipe or food you create is shared both ways — nobody logs the same lasagna twice.
tour_profile_guide_text: Every formula and acronym in the app, in plain words. When in doubt, it is here.
tour_profile_preferences_text: Open Preferences to change language, theme, and to turn this tutorial on or off whenever you like.
tour_diet_start_text: Tap breakfast, lunch or dinner to open that meal and log what you ate.
tour_progress_log_text: Tap here whenever you step on the scale. If it measures fat and muscle, you can log those too.
tour_workout_history_text: Every finished workout is logged here: routine, date, and how many sets you did.
tour_workout_archived_text: A routine that leaves your current cycle is not deleted — it stays here, ready to reactivate whenever you want.
tour_diet_repeat_meal_text: Tap the repeat icon to copy this same meal from the day before, without logging it all again.
tour_diet_repeat_day_text: When the day was just like yesterday, one tap here copies breakfast, lunch, dinner and the rest at once.
tour_diet_foods_recipes_text: Search for what you are about to eat, or tap "+" to add your own food or recipe — the macros are calculated for you. Anything you create can be shared with whoever lives with you, over in Profile.
tour_feedback_fab_title: Found a bug or have an idea?
tour_feedback_fab_text: This button follows you on every screen. Tap it to send feedback directly; press and drag to move it out of your way.
